desc:
Launch a bottle rocket further every time! 🚀

Train POWER, kneel on the LAUNCH ZONE and blast your bottle rocket down a 4,500m strip through 10 zones, then unlock whole new worlds.

🍭 NEW World 4: the CANDY KINGDOM. Fly over Gumdrop Hills, Soda Springs and the Chocolate River all the way to the Cake Castle
🌍 4 worlds: the Science Fair, SPACE, the Giant House and the Candy Kingdom
💪 Train POWER on the practice lanes, up to 40000x
🚀 Unlock 33 bottle rockets, from a Water Bottle to Royal Syrup, with auras
🎈 Steer into balloons mid-flight for +1 POWER
🏆 Earn Wins at every zone and Rebirth for bigger multipliers
🧪 Drink 2x POWER, 2x WINS and LUCK potions
🎟️ Redeem codes (try CANDYKINGDOM) and climb the leaderboards

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite for updates!
